## A workshop for paper that wants to leave the ground
%% sitetile: hero %%

We cut bamboo, we fold paper, and once a month we walk to the river to find out whether we were
right. This fixture site exists so the build has a home page to produce.

## What we make
%% sitetile: grid cols=2 %%

### Deltas
A single spar, a wide mouth, and enough lift to stay up on a still afternoon.

### Box kites
Four cells, more wind needed, and worth every gram of the extra bamboo.

## Terms

A nested page. Its path must stay nested all the way through — `legal/terms.md` in the IR becomes
the page path `legal/terms`, the file `content/legal/terms.md`, and the route `/legal/terms/`. A
collector that flattened it would put a stray `/terms` at the top of the site instead.

## The people and the birds

This page's own FILENAME is the fixture. `our team & friends` is a legal page path in the IR and an
illegal one on disk once it is a route segment, so the collector keeps it verbatim (it emits data)
and the staging step is where the spaces and the ampersand become dashes.

## 關於

這一頁的檔名本身就是測試：CJK slug 是真實網站上活著的網址，消毒規則必須保留 Unicode 字母，
所以這頁的路徑一路到 `content/zh-tw/關於.md` 都不會被改寫成破折號。
